validated_results.title: Dietary Consumption of Antioxidant Vitamins in Relation to Prostate Cancer Risk in Japanese Men: The Japan Public Health Center-based Prospective Study.
validated_results.reason: Prospective cohort of Japanese men with FFQ-assessed dietary vitamin C intake and incident prostate cancer as the outcome.

sample_size.excerpt: 40,720 men without history of cancer finished the food frequency questionnaire (FFQ) and were included in the study.

cases.excerpt: After an average of 15.2 years (617,599 person-years in total) of follow-up, 1,386 cases of prostate cancer were identified, including 944 localized cases and 340 advanced cases.

comparison.excerpt: calculated according to the quintiles of energy-adjusted intake of vitamins using Cox models

design.excerpt: the Japan Public Health Center-based Prospective (JPHC) study
